source: ERIC Thesaurus alphabetical browse pages, https://eric.ed.gov/?ti=<letter>, and term pages, https://eric.ed.gov/?ti=<Term+Name>
method: Each term was checked for an exact, current (non-italic) entry. Italic entries with a year, e.g. 'Climate Change (2004)', are retired descriptors and are not used; italic entries without a year are synonyms ('Instead of this term use') and are not used either. Terms first checked on 2026-11-01 were checked on the alphabetical browse pages. The C and S browse pages were truncated when retrieved, so the 16 remaining terms (Content Validity, Correlation, Critical Thinking, STEM Education, Stereotypes, Student Attitudes, Student Behavior, Student Centered Learning, Student Interests, Student Motivation, Student Records, Study Habits, Study Skills, Summer Programs, Surveys, Synchronous Communication) were checked on 2026-11-06 against each term's own thesaurus page, https://eric.ed.gov/?ti=<Term+Name>; each is a current descriptor (not a synonym or retired term) in the thesaurus as last updated in 2025. scripts/verify_eric_descriptors.py re-checks every term against the official thesaurus download (https://eric.ed.gov/?download). Exports include only 'verified' descriptors. Added 2026-11-06 after checking each term's ERIC Thesaurus page: Ethnography, Participant Observation, Teachers, and Teaching Assistants (with College Faculty, already verified) for the ethnographic study design, the ethnography data collection method, and the educators participant role.

rejected.Hispanic Serving Institutions: Retired descriptor; use Minority Serving Institutions.
rejected.Tribally Controlled Colleges: Not an ERIC descriptor; use Tribally Controlled Education.
